definitions: To overthink or worry excessively about something.
To be consumed by thoughts or anxieties regarding a particular issue.
examples: Don't be in your head about it; it's not as bad as you think.
She's been in her head about the presentation all week.
He tends to be in his head about every little detail.
lemma: to be in one's head about it
source: to be in one's head about it
